sentences.text: The type species Paralligator gradilifrons could reach a maximum length of four meters.
Konzhukova first described the genus in 1954 based on the species Paralligator gradilifrons.
Later, in 2015, Turner classified the species P. ancestralis as a junior synonym of P. gradilifrons.
Its teeth were adapted to crush bivalves, gastropods, and other shelled or exoskeleton-bearing animals.
Because its skull morphology does not suggest it was an ambush predator, researchers hypothesize its diet consisted of aquatic invertebrates.
The braincase shows cerebral hemispheres that are roughly 2.5 times wider than the olfactory tract.
Paralligator likely had to lift its entire head out of the water to breathe.
This crocodylomorph belongs to the family Paralligatoridae.
Three species previously placed in the genus Shamosuchus are now considered synonyms of Paralligator.
Fossils of Paralligator have been found in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia.
One estimate places its existence between 96 and 70 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous.
However, other dating suggests it lived from the Cenomanian to the Santonian stages, between 100.5 and 83.6 million years ago.
